Launch date: March 22, 2019
Source: Italy (IT)
Launch site: FRENCH GUIANA (FRGUI)

PRISMA (Precursore Iperspettrale della Missione Applicativa) is designed to provide information about environmental monitoring, resources management, pollution and crop health. The satellite includes a medium resolution camera that can view across all visual wavelengths, as well as a hyperspectral imager that can capture a wider range of wavelengths between 400 and 2500 nanometers.
